decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed scheme, by reason of its bulk, scale, appearance and proximity of built development to the Green Belt would be conspicuous from, and would harm the open aspect and visual amenities of the Green Belt. The proposed amenity space on adjacent Green Belt Land, due to its enclosure, treatment and relationship to the housing development, would not comply with the objectives for the Use of Green Belt Land, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-N.1.1 (Purposes of including land in and objectives for the use of land in the Green Belt), ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable development in the Green Belt) and ENV-N.1.4 (Development near the Green Belt boundary).

Condition : 2 - The proposed development would not provide a sufficient level of affordable housing on a former employment site, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policy H.2.1 (Affordable housing) and E.1.5 (Development involving loss of or changes in employment generating uses).

Condition : 3 - The proposed development would represent an unacceptable overdevelopment of the site, which would provide substandard private amenity space, inadequate privacy, poor environmental conditions for residents and would fail to provide access or housing for people with disabilities. The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV- B.1.8 (Access and facilities for people with disabilities), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.5.1 (Housing for people with disabilities).
description: Erection of two x part 3/part 4 storey blocks comprising 51 two bedroom units and 6 one bedroom units with 78 parking spaces and amenity area.
